stages.description: Stage names the person can work. Empty unless `kind` is `stages`.

Actor.description:
A person or agent, resolved to the record the screens show.
Fields a particular card does not carry are null.

Attachment.description: A file or link dropped onto a topic, or attached to a filed lane.

cardContext.description: The short paragraph on the decision card. The full page uses `context`.

ThemePatch.description: Partial theme written by `prefs.set`. Every field may be omitted.
